description.narrative: In South Africa, Government and Employers (Private Sector) have been working towards the development of a Private Sector Monitoring and Evaluation Strategy in the area of HIV. The purpose of this framework is to facilitate and improve data collection, reporting and analysis of People Living with HIV in the world of work, and will be aligned to the National Strategic Plan 2023 - 2028 adopted in March 2023. The agency of Government hosting this initiative and which will be the custodian of the strategy is the South African National AIDS Council (SANAC). The process of developing the framework is conducted in consultation with Social Partners, particularly the Employers (Private Sector Forum). The process of developing the strategy, includes but not limited to: • Establishing a Task-Team to coordinate the assignment. • Development of Terms of Reference for the Consultant to develop a Private Sector Forum (PSF) mapping tool, M&E framework and Plan for data collection, reporting and analysis aligned to the NSP 2023-2028, including the development of corresponding M&E tools. • Launch of the Strategy. • Operationalization of the strategy. The work towards the development of the strategy is underway, and will be concluded this year (2023) and the strategy will be launched on the 1st of December 2023. The ILO has provided technical guidance on the establishment of the Task-Team comprised of Government and Employers (March 2023). Terms of Reference have been developed and adopted through technical guidance from the ILO and the Task-Team. A consultant has been recruited to develop the PSF mapping tool, M&E framework and Plan for data collection, reporting and analysis.
